name: Gas pump
summary: The road trip's gas and toll receipts rung up on a drawn pump, split evenly by everyone who rode; one nozzle per rider clicks home when they pay the driver back.
useWhen: paying back whoever drove for gas after a road trip: 'will drove the sube 412 miles, how much do we owe him'
gas and toll receipts scattered in the chat: '$38.40 sunoco', '$41.12 at the wawa', '$12 tolls'
'venmo me for gas' after a drive
dontUseWhen: splitting a ride by distance or drop-off (use uber-segments)
a shared bill that isn't a car trip (use a bill split)

trip.description: Trip or chat name, e.g. 'lake placid trip'

driver.description: Who drove and paid at the pump

receipts.description: 1 to 4 receipts from the chat, in cents

riders.description: Everyone in the car, driver included, 2 to 8

paid.description: Riders who already paid, with what they said
